prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Miami. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I’ll find specific orthodontists in Miami and explain why each is a good choice — but first I need a few quick details so the recommendations match your needs.

Please tell me:
- Your zip code or neighborhood in Miami (so I can find nearby offices).  
- Whether you/your child prefer braces, Invisalign, or are open to either.  
- Age (child, teen, adult).  
- Whether you have orthodontic insurance or a particular dental plan (or need providers who accept Medicaid/Florida KidCare).  
- Any other priorities (Saturday hours, Spanish-speaking staff, low-cost options, interest in lingual or accelerated orthodontics, etc.)

If you want a quick start without details, I can also give general tips now on how to choose and where to look:
- Search the AAO “Find an Orthodontist” and Invisalign provider locators to confirm credentials and provider level (Invisalign Platinum/Diamond indicates high volume/experience).  
- Prefer an orthodontist who is a licensed orthodontist (DDS/DMD + residency in orthodontics) and ideally ABO board-certified (Diplomate of the American Board of Orthodontics) — that’s the specialty standard.  
- Ask each office these questions in your consult: Are you board-certified? How many Invisalign cases have you treated? Do you use iTero/3D digital scans? Estimated treatment time and total cost? What’s included (retainers, refinements, emergency visits)? Payment plan options? Who handles emergencies after hours?  
- Typical price range (very approximate): $3,000–$7,000+ for traditional braces, $3,500–$8,000+ for Invisalign — actual cost varies by case complexity and practice.  
- Look at recent Google/Yelp reviews and before/after photos; check how the practice handles missed trays or poor tracking for Invisalign.

If you give me your zip/neighborhood and preferences, I’ll compile a short list (4–6) of specific Miami orthodontists, with reasons to call each, contact info, and what to ask at your consult. Which zip or neighborhood should I search?
